name: codemode
description: One codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the session's tools, and only the script's output returns.

mcpCodemode.title: MCP servers behind codemode
mcpCodemode.description: Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model reaches only through the codemode tool.

mcpDeferred.title: MCP servers deferred
mcpDeferred.description: Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model loads on demand through tool search.

mcpDirect.title: MCP servers direct
mcpDirect.description: Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model sees with their full schemas every turn.

mcpHidden.title: MCP servers hidden
mcpHidden.description: Servers or tools (server, server__tool, server__prefix*), separated by commas, the model does not see at all.
